text:
olivia-fin: Morning  batch for Ascendia (monthly) processed at 08:00 UTC. 5 invoices, 2 cards declined (one `EXPIRED_CARD`, one `DO_NOT_HONOR`), and one ACH attempt bounced back (NACHA return: `R29 BENEFICIARY NAME/SECURITY ENTRY ERROR`). Need plan: retries, fix ACH, and any temporary credit.

henry-payments: Can you drop last4 and payment ids? I want to check token expiry date vs vault.

olivia-fin: last4: 4012 (expired), 8890 (do_not_honor), ACH txn id ach_3f4a... (return code R29). Payment ids DMed.

billing-bot: [system] payment.failed events=3 codes=[EXPIRED_CARD, DO_NOT_HONOR, R29_RETURN]

sophia-support: Ticket #9132: customer asked "We just updated bank info last week, why did ACH bounce?" They asked for clear next steps and whether service will be interrupted.

henry-payments: Plan: 1) For expired card: send secure card update link and do not retry old token. 2) For DO_NOT_HONOR: pause retries and offer alternate routing or wire. 3) For ACH R29: send ACH verify link and note that return R29 means beneficiary name mismatch; customer likely provided trade name vs legal name. Ask them to confirm exact beneficiary name on their payroll/invoice. 4) Offer one-time short-term grace (Net-7) to avoid disruption while they correct ACH.

carlos-ops: Approving Net-7 up to $12k for Ascendia while payment is being corrected. I'll add metadata temp_terms=net7_12k and ops_reminder=day6.

maya-legal: Wording: do not say "bounced" to the customer. Use neutral phrasing: "the ACH was returned due to beneficiary name mismatch (return code R29)". Also require any temporary credit approvals to be recorded in Zendesk and in account metadata.

olivia-fin: Draft message to send to customer:

"Hi Ascendia  We attempted to process your scheduled invoices but a subset of payments did not complete: one saved card is expired, one card was declined by the issuing bank, and an ACH attempt was returned due to a beneficiary name mismatch (NACHA R29). No funds were captured.

Options: 1) Update card via secure link and we can retry (we will not retry expired tokens). 2) Correct the beneficiary name in your ACH details and we will re-initiate verification (microdeposits). 3) We can provide an invoice link and accept a manual wire. 4) If helpful, we can place this invoice on a one-time 7-day term while payment is arranged.

Please reply with which you prefer and we will proceed.

 Redwood Billing"

sophia-support: Sending that now in ticket #9132 via secure channel and included card update + ACH intake links.

henry-payments: I'll pause all automated retries. If they pick card update, we'll do a single manual retry after new token is added. If they fix ACH, we'll re-run microdeposit verification. Commands: 

```
/payments set-meta --acct acct_ascendia --temp_terms net7_12k
/payments pause-retries --payment-ids pay_4012...,pay_8890...,ach_3f4a...
```

billing-bot: [system] secure.card_update_link created https://redwood-payments/update/ct_9a8b (expires 24h). ach.verify_link https://redwood-payments/verify/ach_3f4a (expires 7d). invoice.link created https://redwood-invoices/local/ln_asc-9132 (expires 7d).

cfo-approvals: Approved temporary Net-7 up to $12k for Ascendia. Recorded approval id=appr_6621.

olivia-fin: Updated account note: "temp_terms=net7_12k approved by cfo-approvals; retries paused; card update & ACH verify links sent; waiting for customer reply."

maya-legal: Reminder: when they provide beneficiary name, verify via secure intake form and do not paste name or bank details in Slack. Record verification status only.

sophia-support: Customer replied in ticket: "We'll correct ACH beneficiary to legal name and confirm. Please wait on retries." :white_check_mark:

henry-payments: Cancelling scheduled retries and marking payments awaiting_ach. Will re-initiate microdeposits once support confirms corrected name.

billing-bot: [system] payment.metadata updated account=acct_ascendia awaiting_payment=ach temp_terms=net7_12k approval=appr_6621

carlos-ops: I'll review on day 6; if ACH not verified, collections will open on day 8.

olivia-fin: Closing thread  status: customer chose ACH fix, retries paused, ACH verify link sent, Net-7 approved. Will reconcile after verification completes. :thumbsup:
